name: Cultist: Presence of N'Zoth grows its Tentacle out of the caster (#8638)
contract: Presence of N'Zoth 803037 (Spell.dbc) is a proc aura; its client description reads 'giving damage dealt a $h% chance to summon Tentacles on your back that attack a nearby enemy for $500707d'. Spell.dbc carries no summon effect for it: aura_ascension_cultist_event's 803037 branch calls AscensionCultist::Summon(500464, ...) directly, so its placement and appearance are the script's choice. The 'on your back' half is a client visual, not a world object: the Ascension client accepts SMSG_OVERRIDE_SPELL_VISUAL (0x662, u64 guid, u32 spell, u32 visual; AuraScript-side AscSpellVisuals) and renders a spell's StateKit models at the unit's attachment points while its aura is up. Eldritch Tentacle 500707 is the carrier - it has an 8 sec dummy aura on the caster and its shipped SpellVisual is 0 - so the branch sends (caster, 500707, 889830) and applies 500707's aura on the caster; 889830 is the shipped cultist tentacle visual whose StateKit 863071 attaches six cfx_priest_voidform_tentacle models at attachment points 5/6 (shoulders/upper back). The attacking creature 500464 is still summoned for the silence and the 8 sec lifetime, but at the caster and hidden from rendering, because a visible Yogg-Saron tentacle standing on the ground beside the cultist is exactly the #8638 report. Unit::SetVisible(false) alone is not enough: WorldObject::CanSeeOrDetect returns true early for obj->IsAlwaysVisibleFor(seer), and Unit::IsAlwaysVisibleFor answers true when the seer is the summon's charmer or owner, so the caster kept receiving and rendering their own carrier even though no other player did - which is why this check reads owned_creature_display (the model the client is told to render) and not only the object's visibility flag. The carrier therefore also swaps to display 11686 (InvisibleStalker) and drops UNIT_FLAG_NOT_SELECTABLE. A direct 500707 cast (the learnable Eldritch Tentacle ability, whose client description summons the tentacle at the target location) is untouched and must stay visible. Expected: damage summons a living 500464 owned by the caster and hidden from clients, the proc leaves the 8 sec 500707 aura on the caster (the visual carrier), the Tentacle silences the enemy whose damage triggered it with 806596, and it still expires on its 8 sec lifetime; casting 500707 directly afterwards summons a visible 500464. Coverage limit: the harness cannot observe client-rendered attached models or the 0x662 packet, so only the aura carrier, the summon's hidden state, its placement and its behaviour are covered.
